prompts.name: joy
prompts.prompt: Precise-object-edit: create a standalone replacement pixel-art robot monitor HEAD sprite matching this reference EXACTLY: wide rectangular light-gray bezel, deep charcoal screen, near-black navy outer rim, small rectangular gray ear tabs on both sides. Head ONLY, no neck or body. Keep the same silhouette, proportions, camera angle and colors for the entire set. Reproduce the reference head large and centered on a square canvas with narrow transparent padding. The checkerboard in the reference is NOT part of the asset: use actual alpha transparency outside the head. Change ONLY the face display. Bright pale cyan large bold pixel-block kaomoji should occupy about 75% of the dark screen width and 65% height. Each stroke thick and crisp for readability at 64px, no tiny embellishments, no bloom, no glow outside strokes, no gradients, flat limited color pixel art. No text labels, no captions, no watermark, no scenery. Expression: 喜: gentle happy ^‿^, upward caret eyes and small closed curved smile.
